Beheeyem

Psychic

Unova · Generation 5

Beheeyem is a Psychic-type Cerebral Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 1 m tall and weighs 34.5 kg. It evolves from Elgyem. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (125), with a base stat total of 485.
